responsibilities: 4.5 years of experience managing end-to-end SOC operations and cloud security services for multiple global clients, ensuring effective monitoring, detection, and response to evolving threats. Proven ability to strengthen security postures through incident response, threat hunting, and automation across diverse cloud environments.
Designed and developed security alerts and automated responses, collaborating with the Incident/Change Management team.
Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Sentinel SIEM and Microsoft 365 Defender tools (MDE, MDI, O365 Defender, MCAS), including DLP implementation.
Configured log sources and data connectors in Sentinel, developed KQL-based detection rules aligned with the MITRE ATTACK framework.
Managed phishing and malware incidents within SLA, executing remediation actions and ensuring regulatory compliance.
Conducted incident triage, log analysis and email analysis to strengthen threat detection capabilities.
Implemented performance improvements by fine-tuning configurations, adding log sources, developing playbooks, and troubleshooting SIEM issues.
Prepared weekly/monthly reports & engaged with Threat Hunting teams to enhance client security posture.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity trends, malware analysis, incident response, and MITRE ATTACK tactics.
Hands-on experience with SOC tools (SIEM, Microsoft Defender, Antivirus, Sentinel) to monitor, detect, and respond to security incidents effectively.
Proactively managed email security solutions (Proofpoint) to safeguard against phishing and advanced email threats.
Conducted in-depth threat intelligence investigations to analyse and mitigate emerging threats.
Supported Varonis DLP solutions, ensuring data protection and compliance with organizational policies.
Configured and optimized Microsoft Sentinel SIEM for log management, event correlation, and advanced threat detection.
Integrated and customized workflows to automate incident response, improving efficiency and reducing manual intervention.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to align incident response with best practices, while contributing to investigations and developing use cases in Sentinel and Defender for proactive threat identification.
